metaTitle: Custom Performance T Shirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom performance t shirts for your team or event. Moisture-wicking fabrics perfect for active use. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom performance t shirts are built for movement and sweat. Unlike standard cotton tees, these shirts use moisture-wicking polyester or blends that pull sweat away from the skin, keeping wearers dry during runs, trade shows, or outdoor workdays. Choose from popular styles like the Sport-Tek Competitor or Port & Company Essential Performance Tee, and add your logo with screen printing or embroidery. Ideal for corporate wellness programs, event staff, or sports teams that need comfort and durability in one shirt.
heroAltText: Custom performance t shirts in moisture-wicking fabric with logo, ideal for active teams and events
